displayTitle: Young Jedi Adventures: My First Comic Reader Level 1
synopsis: A graphic novel short story collection scheduled to be released in June 2023 A collection of adventurous original short stories starring Kai Brightstar, Lys Solay, and Nubs featuring Master Zia, Taborr, and Yoda. Star Wars: My First Comic Readers are easy-to-read comic books that introduce young fans to graphic novels with simple text, accessible layouts, and clear storylines.
